data.one_liner: A Flutter package for drawing dashed circles.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter widget that draws a dashed circle around its child. It can also be used with CustomPaint.
use_when: You need to display a widget surrounded by a dashed circular border
You want a simple way to create dashed profile pictures or avatars
avoid_when: You need complex vector graphics or custom path shapes beyond circles
You need advanced state management or non-UI capabilities
strengths: Easy integration with standard widgets like CircleAvatar
weaknesses: Very limited scope focusing only on dashed circles
Lacks extensive configuration options documented in the README
